description: This file defines the ProviderSearchFilterParams class in PHP, which extends a base FilterParams class and is used to encapsulate filtering parameters for provider searches in the OpenID authentication plugin of the HRM system. It includes properties for name, status, and id, along with their getters and setters, and constants for allowed sort fields.

classes.name: ProviderSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Encapsulates filtering parameters for provider search, including name, status, and id, with allowed sorting options.
